text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
――Our Mejiro family,
in pursuit of glory in the racing world, 
has produced many outstanding Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And among them,
there is one who is much more devoted 
to races than any other……Nee-sama,
Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When my older sister was little,
there was a time where 
she couldn't run. However,
her tenacity helped her 
overcome……when she could run again,
her talent blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
……So much so that, there's probably 
noone in the family that can match her.
choice_data_list: And she still had no trainer……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To be more precise,
there was no one who could put up with
her. 
As for the reason……because my older sister
only loves races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The one thing……that drives me. 
Only races――My love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My sister expressed that love through
"perfection". 
Perfectly conditioning her body,
perfectly strategizing, 
perfectly progressing toward victory……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sparing no effort to achieve that.
Since approaching the start of her career,
she has diligently and 
thoroughly been preparing for a perfect
debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
……due to her stoic nature,
there hasn't been anyone that 
could keep up with her. To my sister,
her world consists of only her and races,
and noone else could enter――

Put another way,
it means she cares about nothing 
else. After being treated like that,
most trainers 
would probably lose confidence in
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
On top of that,
becoming the trainer of "Mejiro Ramonu" 
……would also mean shouldering an incredibly
important commitment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My sister declared it would be proof
of her love but…… 
now that the Symboli family has achieved
the Classic Triple Crown――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Next it is our Mejiro Family,
that must perform its obligation.
In the Triple Tiara rotation, 
becoming the first in history to achieve
it……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
……a glorious achievement like that,
as if it 
were the natural course. Speaking of the 
intense pressure from something like
that……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ……I love Nee-sama's running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was a child,
I was always watching 
that back from so close.
That free running style…… 
I believe it will lead to a significant
track record.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is up to you to choose.
However……please 
treat my older sister well.
As a younger sister 
――and as a member of the Mejiro family,
I ask you.

――Definitely,
she would have been fine with whoever. 
Since her debut had been decided,
and because I was the first to ask,
Mejiro Ramonu had formed a contract.

To her,
the thoughts and emotions of the trainers 
have nothing to do with her……in the course
of the contract,
one might be constantly reminded of this.

――While lost in thought,
I ended up at the course. There were 
many Uma Musume running,
however there was one that stood out……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haaa…… Haaa…… Haaa……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Aaaah…… Fufuu…… Fufufu……!

It was the same as when I first saw her run.
With no facade,
completely……she enjoyed racing from the
bottom her heart. Seeing that,
made my heart skip a beat.

――I felt that she was one of a kind.
From her point of view, 
maybe anyone would have been fine. But for me,
that isn't the case.

As she finished running,
my doubts had cleared. 
I hurried off to start preparing for her
debut――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see.

Ramonu didn't even look in my direction.
That 
lack of interest made me uneasy…… However,
there was something I needed to tell her,
no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――So you like it.
choice_data_list: I want to revise that answer

text_block_list.text:
After being moved by Mejiro Ramonu's
running, 
and observing the depths of her
love……there 
was something that reverberated within me.
I love races.

I love races where them just running gets
my 
blood pumping.
I love races where the Uma Musume 
pour their all in to chasing their dreams.

The whole world changes in an instant after
crossing 
the goal.
Records and memories woven together in 
to a drama―― I really love races……!

That's why, I can say it clearly now.
If it was for the sake of racing,
I'd do anything……if it meant I could 
be a part of that history,
no matter what it was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: The first ever Triple Tiara, with ...
The first ever Triple Tiara, with ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My sister expressed that love through
"perfection". 
Perfectly conditioning her body,
perfectly strategizing, 
perfectly progressing toward victory……

――If it was her,
then she already had a perfect plan.
There 
was no point if the trainer didn't go above
and beyond. Like――

Adding the jewel of "perfect" to complete
the Triple Tiara…… 
winning every single race up to and including
the Triple Tiara――

If running is the way she expresses her love
for racing…… 
then supporting that dream is how a Trainer
should express it.
choice_data_list: For races……For you, I'll give it all
For races……For you, I'll give it all

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Vermillion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The final color I was looking for. 
Now――I've found it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
……It's finished. 
Aaah, with this……it's complete.

I looked at her painting.
It seemed like an abstract painting,
I couldn't tell what it was or how complete
it actually was.
It was as mysterious as the person
herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
……After this,
I'll be revising the menu for the upcoming
year. 
Before moving on to proper training……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Is that acceptable? 
――Trainer-san.

Mejiro Ramonu smiled――and that was how I
first set foot in to her world.
To create a new history, 
using the love of racing as a common
language――
